query:
SELECT c.id,
                  COALESCE(array_agg(s.category ORDER BY s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.id IS NOT NULL), '{}')
                      AS "categories!: Vec<StatusCategory>"
           FROM board_column c
           LEFT JOIN status s ON s.column_id = c.id
           WHERE c.board_id = $1
           GROUP BY c.id
           ORDER BY c.position
